G1_no_parent_from_model_output.criterion: every level-1 and level-2 code AND title is a row in the retrieved source table, mapping_authority is source_table or reviewer, and the record's source hash matches the table

G2_target_parent_not_identical.criterion: no target and no parent share the same normalized text

G3_no_cycle.criterion: gx.build_label_dag accepts the derived chains: no label is its own ancestor and no chain repeats a label

G4_no_incompatible_branches.criterion: one profession has exactly one chain, and no profession is assigned to two level-1 branches

G4b_no_duplicate_targets.scope: selected transformation targets only, not the whole table
G4b_no_duplicate_targets.shared_parent_is_not_a_collision: two different SOC occupations may share a level-1 or level-2 parent; coarsening sibling occupations to a common parent is a legitimate experiment and must not be rejected
G4b_no_duplicate_targets.coverage_counts_distinct_leaves: a duplicate raw profession contributes ZERO additional hierarchy-coverage count; coverage is the number of distinct SOC leaf codes among targets, which must equal the number of targets
G4b_no_duplicate_targets.criterion: no two confirmatory targets share a SOC leaf code, and no two have identical complete chains
G4b_no_duplicate_targets.consequence: Freezing fails until target collisions are resolved: counting one transformation twice overstates how many distinct transformations were tested.
